## Personality

Mr. Bentley is an elderly minister. He is considered by [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to be lacking in imagination.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P4](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0004)_

## History

Bentley arrived in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) as a widower and served as the town's pastor for eighteen years. In the February prior to his departure, he resigned from his charge. He subsequently left [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) accompanied by the regrets of his former congregation.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P4](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0004)_
